---
title: "Perineurial p75NTR layer: annotation consensus, comparison and figure"
output: html_document
---

# Perineurial p75NTR⁺ layer in invaded vs non-invaded nerves

Three annotators independently scored each nerve image for the presence of a
surrounding p75NTR⁺ perineurial layer. A separate annotation assigned each nerve
to invaded or non-invaded. The reported outcome is the majority vote of the three
annotators.

ANALYSIS SET
  All annotated nerves are included. An earlier version of this analysis was
  restricted to nerves for which none of the annotators had recorded a comment
  (i.e. unambiguous cases). That restriction was checked and rejected: comments
  were recorded far more often for invaded than for non-invaded nerves
  (see "Check: is the comment-based exclusion balanced?" below), so excluding
  commented nerves would have selected against ambiguous cases specifically in
  the group of interest. The full set is therefore reported, and the restricted
  set is retained only as a sensitivity analysis.

UNIT OF ANALYSIS
  All images derive from a single patient, so each nerve is treated as an
  individual data point and no patient-level term is required.

INPUTS
  input/nerve_classification.xlsx   invaded / non-invaded call per image
  input/nerve_annotator_1.xlsx      p75NTR layer: annotator 1 (image, label, comments)
  input/nerve_annotator_2.xlsx      annotator 2
  input/nerve_annotator_3.xlsx      annotator 3

OUTPUTS
  output/classification/consensus_per_nerve.csv
  output/classification/contingency_tables.csv
  output/classification/surrounding_p75ntr_line_plot.pdf / .png

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(irr)
})

IN_DIR  <- "input"
OUT_DIR <- file.path("output", "classification")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Load annotations

```{r load}
read_required <- function(file) {
  path <- file.path(IN_DIR, file)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Input not found: ", path)
  read_excel(path)
}

# Nerve-category annotation (invaded / non-invaded)
cancer_class <- read_required("nerve_classification.xlsx")

# Perineurial-layer annotation, three independent annotators
nerve_class_1 <- read_required("nerve_annotator_1.xlsx")
nerve_class_2 <- read_required("nerve_annotator_2.xlsx")
nerve_class_3 <- read_required("nerve_annotator_3.xlsx")
```

## 2. Merge and derive the consensus call

```{r merge}
merged <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "image", all = TRUE),
                 list(nerve_class_1, nerve_class_2, nerve_class_3))
names(merged) <- c("image", "label_1", "comments_1",
                   "label_2", "comments_2", "label_3", "comments_3")

merged_all <- merge(merged, cancer_class[, c("image", "label")],
                    by = "image", all.x = TRUE)
colnames(merged_all)[colnames(merged_all) == "label"] <- "label_cancer"

# Majority vote across the three annotators
majority_vote <- function(x) {
  tab <- table(x)
  if (length(tab) == 0) return(NA)
  names(which.max(tab))
}

merged_all$consensus <- apply(
  merged_all[, c("label_1", "label_2", "label_3")], 1, majority_vote)

# Flag nerves for which any annotator left a comment (used only for the
# exclusion check and the sensitivity analysis below)
merged_all$any_comment <- !(is.na(merged_all$comments_1) &
                            is.na(merged_all$comments_2) &
                            is.na(merged_all$comments_3))

analysis_df <- merged_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(label_1), !is.na(label_2), !is.na(label_3)) %>%   # all three raters
  filter(!is.na(label_cancer), !is.na(consensus)) %>%
  transmute(
    image,
    any_comment,
    cancer_class = factor(label_cancer,
                          levels = c("Non Invaded Nerve", "Invaded Nerve"),
                          labels = c("Non-invaded nerve", "Invaded nerve")),
    line = factor(consensus,
                  levels = c("Surrounding Line", "No Surrounding Line"),
                  labels = c("Present", "Absent")))

write_csv(analysis_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "consensus_per_nerve.csv"))
nrow(analysis_df)
```

## 3. Inter-annotator agreement

```{r kappa}
# Report alongside the comparison: the outcome is a consensus call, so its
# reliability belongs in the figure legend.
kappa_all <- kappam.fleiss(merged_all[, c("label_1", "label_2", "label_3")])
kappa_all

kappa_df <- merged_all %>%
  filter(image %in% analysis_df$image) %>%
  select(label_1, label_2, label_3)
kappa_analysed <- kappam.fleiss(kappa_df)
kappa_analysed
```

## 4. Check: is the comment-based exclusion balanced?

```{r exclusion-check}
# If annotators flag doubts more often in one group, restricting the analysis
# to uncommented nerves would bias the comparison. This is the test that
# decided the analysis set.
excl_tab <- table(analysis_df$cancer_class, analysis_df$any_comment)
dimnames(excl_tab)[[2]] <- c("no comment", "comment")
excl_tab
round(100 * prop.table(excl_tab, 1), 1)
excl_test <- fisher.test(excl_tab)
excl_test
```

## 5. Primary comparison — all annotated nerves

```{r primary}
tab <- table(analysis_df$cancer_class, analysis_df$line)
addmargins(tab)
round(100 * prop.table(tab, 1), 1)   # % per nerve category

ft <- fisher.test(tab)
ft

# Report proportions and the p value rather than the odds ratio: one cell is
# near-empty, so the OR and its confidence interval are unstable.
p_present <- prop.table(tab, 1)[, "Present"]
cat(sprintf(
  "Perineurial p75NTR+ layer present in %.1f%% of non-invaded (n = %d) and %.1f%% of invaded nerves (n = %d); Fisher's exact p = %.3g\n",
  100 * p_present["Non-invaded nerve"], sum(tab["Non-invaded nerve", ]),
  100 * p_present["Invaded nerve"],     sum(tab["Invaded nerve", ]),
  ft$p.value))
```

## 6. Sensitivity analysis — unambiguous nerves only

```{r sensitivity}
# Restricted to nerves without annotator comments. Reported only to show that
# the conclusion does not depend on the analysis set.
tab_sens <- with(filter(analysis_df, !any_comment), table(cancer_class, line))
tab_sens
round(100 * prop.table(tab_sens, 1), 1)
ft_sens <- fisher.test(tab_sens)
ft_sens
```

```{r save-tables}
# Both contingency tables in one file, for the supplement
tab_to_df <- function(x, label) {
  as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    setNames(c("cancer_class", "line", "n")) %>%
    mutate(analysis = label)
}

bind_rows(
  tab_to_df(tab,      "All annotated nerves"),
  tab_to_df(tab_sens, "Without annotator comments")
) %>%
  relocate(analysis) %>%
  write_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "contingency_tables.csv"))
```

## 7. Figure

```{r figure, fig.width=4.8, fig.height=4.2}
# p value taken from the test above, so the figure cannot go out of date.
# Below 0.001 it is written as a x 10^b, otherwise as a plain number.
format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("italic(p) == NA")
  if (p >= 0.001) return(sprintf("italic(p) == %s", formatC(p, format = "fg", digits = 2)))
  e <- floor(log10(p))
  m <- signif(p / 10^e, 2)
  sprintf("italic(p) == %s %%*%% 10^%d", m, e)
}

p_label <- format_p(ft$p.value)

plot_df <- analysis_df %>%
  count(cancer_class, line, name = "count")

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(cancer_class, count, fill = line)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill",
           width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 5, colour = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) x * 100,
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Absent" = "lightblue", "Present" = "orange")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Nerves [%]", fill = "Surrounding\np75NTR+ line") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.key        = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.line    = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.7, "cm"),
    plot.margin  = margin(8, 8, 8, 8))

p1 <- p +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = 1.05, yend = 1.05, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 1.09, label = p_label, parse = TRUE, size = 4.5) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.12), clip = "off")

p1

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "surrounding_p75ntr_line_plot.pdf"),
       p1, width = 4.8, height = 4.2, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "surrounding_p75ntr_line_plot.png"),
       p1, width = 4.8, height = 4.2, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r legend, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  paste0("\n**Figure legend.** Presence of a surrounding p75NTR+ perineurial layer in ",
         "non-invaded (n = %d) and invaded (n = %d) nerves of one patient. Each nerve was ",
         "scored independently by three annotators; the reported call is their majority ",
         "vote (Fleiss' kappa = %.2f). Numbers in the bars are nerve counts. ",
         "Fisher's exact test, p = %.3g.\n"),
  sum(tab["Non-invaded nerve", ]), sum(tab["Invaded nerve", ]),
  kappa_analysed$value, ft$p.value))
```
